subject: Skip static Lua engine loading in Sentinel mode (#4327)
reason: The change only skips static Lua engine loading when the process starts in Sentinel mode. Non-sentinel servers (the only kind the fuzzer can deploy: standalone and cluster) take the exact same code path as the parent build, so no compared command, tool run, or fault scenario can observe a difference. Sentinel mode is enabled only by argv/exec-name (--sentinel / valkey-sentinel), not by any server_config directive, and no installed experiment, component, or deployment mode supports Sentinel, so the changed path is unreachable by the fuzzer.
